name: Jinlee
source:
A calm and calculating beauty, she always carries a small handgun Armament with her, but when it deploys it transforms into a heavy weapon with multiple turrets which rains burning destruction on all. 

She's extremely interested in pre-Cataclysm novels, comics and movies and is secretly gathering a collection on the side.
